subject.title: [Bug]: Heartbeat / async system events can interrupt and effectively swallow in-progress replies in Telegram topic sessions

question: Should this issue remain the broad canonical tracker for Telegram topic heartbeat/system-event reply loss, stale replay, and delivery-boundary failures, or should it be narrowed to the original active-reply heartbeat race covered by the linked PR?
rationale: Current main and the latest release cover part of the original race, but live comments report broader Telegram symptoms that may need a maintainer-owned boundary decision before implementation scope is safe.

options.title: Keep Broad Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical tracker and require the linked PR or follow-up work to prove exactly which symptoms are fixed.

options.title: Split And Narrow
options.body: Move stale replay/default-target leakage and delivery-boundary symptoms into separate canonical issues, then land or reject the narrow heartbeat guard independently.

recommendation.title: Keep Broad Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical tracker and require the linked PR or follow-up work to prove exactly which symptoms are fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest available routing candidate from the sampled history for the combined heartbeat, reply, and delivery-boundary surfaces.
